name: Hermes Agent
description: Self-hosted AI agent from Nous Research with persistent memory, auto-created skills, scheduled jobs and a chat gateway for Telegram, Discord, Slack and more, with a password-protected web dashboard and an OpenAI-compatible API.

settings.label: Model providers
settings.description: Optional. The agent needs a model to answer: add a provider key here, or sign in to Nous Portal and add keys later from the dashboard. Keys are stored as secrets and never shown again.

endpoints.label: Dashboard
endpoints.help: Sign-in is required. Use a domain with HTTPS where you can; this agent can run commands for whoever signs in.

endpoints.label: OpenAI-compatible API
endpoints.help: Reachable by other apps on the same host. Every /v1 request requires the generated API key.

features.title: An agent that learns
features.description: Persistent memory, skills it writes for itself, sub-agents and scheduled jobs.

features.title: Chat where you already are
features.description: A gateway for Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp and Signal, plus an OpenAI-compatible API.

features.title: Your data stays with you
features.description: Config, memory and sessions live in one volume on your server; bring your own model provider.

configFields.label: Dashboard password
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Shown on the Connection card.

configFields.label: Dashboard session signing key
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Keeps dashboard sessions valid across restarts.

configFields.label: API key
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Bearer token for the OpenAI-compatible API.

connection.title: Sign in to Hermes Agent
connection.description: Sign in to the dashboard with the username and generated password below. The API key is the bearer token for the OpenAI-compatible API on port 8642 (reachable by other apps on the same host).

firstLogin.note: Security: this agent can run commands and use the model keys stored here for anyone who can sign in or message it through a chat channel. Prefer a domain with HTTPS, turn on the edge password for the hostname, keep the chat allowlists tight, and run it on a server you do not share with production apps. The agent needs a model before it can answer: add a provider key in the dashboard, or run 'hermes setup --portal' from the service terminal. Chat platforms (Telegram, Discord, Slack) are connected from the dashboard or the service terminal. Config, memory and sessions are kept in one volume, so redeployment keeps them. Do not run a second Hermes against the same volume.
